label: synthetic
workload: Cline / Roo / Aider style: XML-ish tool protocol in the system prompt, one tool per turn, and a client that rewrites history mid-conversation

source.note: Shaped after the published tool protocol of Cline-family agents (a single tool call per message, tool results fed back as user turns). No captured bytes, no copied prose.

cline.system: You are a highly skilled software engineer. You accomplish tasks one step at a time, using exactly one tool per message, and wait for the result before continuing. Tool use is formatted with XML tags. Always read a file before editing it.

function.name: execute_command
function.description: Run a CLI command on the user's system

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the contents of a file at the given path

function.name: write_to_file
function.description: Write full content to a file, creating directories as needed

function.name: replace_in_file
function.description: Apply SEARCH/REPLACE blocks to a file

function.name: ask_followup_question
function.description: Ask the user a clarifying question

turns.comment: The client edited a historical message (a retry with a corrected earlier prompt). Same length, same position, different content: this is NOT the same conversation, and joining it would be a false continuation.
And a reorder of two prior messages, which is equally not a continuation.
